label: Prompt Generation
title: Prompt Generation
subtitle: AI-powered prompt engineering tools. Agents can generate, improve, and analyse system prompts for other agents — useful for building self-improving pipelines or onboarding new custom agents.
whenToUse: Use when you want an agent to help design a system prompt for a new agent, refine an existing prompt based on observed performance, or generate test cases to validate a prompt.

methods.name: Generate Agent Prompt
methods.description: Creates a professional system prompt for a new agent based on its name, role, and description.

methods.name: Improve Prompt
methods.description: Optimises an existing prompt based on feedback and goals.

methods.name: Generate Test Cases
methods.description: Creates diverse test inputs for validating a prompt.

methods.name: Analyse Improvements
methods.description: Compares two prompt versions and analyses the differences.

methods.name: Create Initial Draft
methods.description: Converts a simple prompt into a structured template.

methods.name: Refine Chain of Thought
methods.description: Adds systematic reasoning steps to an existing prompt.

methods.name: Enhance Examples
methods.description: Improves example quality in a prompt with detailed reasoning.

mediaCaption: A Generate Agent Prompt action card returning a structured system prompt with role definition, capabilities, and behavioural constraints
